reason: Free for 3 months and they do the setup, so I can try it without risk. I already take most orders on WhatsApp and the udhaar diary does get messy, so I'd give it a go. I'd only keep paying if it proves itself.
objection: Will it really catch my phone-call orders correctly without me doing anything? Calls are noisy at the counter, and if I have to fix every card, it's more work than my diary.
would_change_my_mind: If it can't get phone-call orders right in the first week or two of the free trial, I'd drop it. A clear explanation of how it hears calls would also help.
